description.value: Open-air bus tour candidates start with Big Bus Tours. Wikipedia describes the company as an operator of open top bus sightseeing tours, and says it operates in 28 cities of 18 countries with 444 buses operating around the world. Typically, Big Bus Tours use open top double-decker buses in burgundy and cream-coloured livery, and New York is one of its listed cities. Check the current New York route map and ticket prices on the operator's site before booking.
